scope: Homogeneous observation/classification of four legal input witnesses. Control commands and planner goals are not distinct human decisions. Search policy differs for N2.

definitions.controlCategories: Mutually exclusive by buttons; a held jump is not a new jump.
definitions.neutral: No horizontal/jump/drop/use input; movement can continue.
definitions.interactions: Observed automatic pickups, door opening, checkpoint changes, conductor hits and clear.
definitions.phases: Intervals attributed to authored planner targets, not mandatory gameplay phases.
